name: minimind
description: Agent skills for MiniMind: from-scratch tiny LLM training (pretrain, SFT, LoRA, DPO, PPO/GRPO/CISPO, Agentic RL), evaluation, and OpenAI-compatible serving.

interface.shortDescription: Train and serve MiniMind from scratch
interface.longDescription: Skills for the MiniMind repository: environment and dataset setup, MiniMind Zero pretrain+SFT reproduction, LoRA and RL (DPO / PPO / GRPO / CISPO / Agentic RL), checkpoint chat via eval_llm.py, and OpenAI-compatible API serving plus torch↔transformers conversion.
defaultPrompt: Set up MiniMind and download the mini datasets for MiniMind Zero.
Reproduce MiniMind Zero with pretrain then SFT.
Chat with my full_sft checkpoint using eval_llm.py.
